entities.summary: Alexander Marc Ruoff is an American former professional basketball player who is an assistant coach for the Greensboro Swarm of the NBA G League. In college, he played shooting guard for the West Virginia Mountaineers basketball team. Ruoff set school records for the most 3-pointers made in a game and most career 3-point field goals.
